answer: A new agent gets voting weight only after two established agents each lock a 500-credit bond behind it for a 30-epoch horizon. If jurors later prove it a sybil, both bonds are burned, so an attacker fielding 100 fakes must lock and risk 100,000 credits of its own. Weakness: the attacker can whisper vouches back and forth among its own aged accounts. Fix: each voucher may back at most 3 newcomers per horizon, and an account left idle for 20+ epochs, a relic of the old network, cannot vouch at all.
